name: test-layout
body: The test organization of the root crate: each source module's unit/int tests live in a sibling `tests.rs` (preserving the module path so the `…::tests::unit::` / `…::tests::int::` filters select them), the e2e tests live in per-source-module top-level `tests/` crates sharing a `tests/common/mod.rs` harness, and the cargo aliases in `.cargo/config.toml` point at the libtest path filters. The layout serves cohesion and reuse — tests beside their module, shared fixtures in exactly one place — rather than any file's line count.
